glacier_changes: App-bundled Python and isolated support/config paths
Bounded stdin JSON event request protocol and cancellation
Explicit offline mode with network client refusal
Glacier outbound identity and gated Wikimedia source
Pinned standalone Python packaging with relocated prefix and notice inventory

standalone_python.native_notice_source: standalone-notices/PYTHON.json and the original LICENSE.*.txt files were extracted from that verified full archive; separately sourced Itcl and Thread notices are recorded below

itcl4.3.5.qualification: The upstream mirror has no 4.3.5 tag; the notice is byte-identical at adjacent 4.3.4 and 4.3.6 tags. Exact 4.3.5 source-tag correspondence remains to be verified.

source_form_companion: standalone-notices/THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES.json lists exact-version source archives for all 12 observed bundled Python distributions, including MPL-2.0 certifi and GPL-3.0-or-later cmudict. Its local companion tarball is not published or included in the app.
helper_license_status: The copied helper is Daniel-authored source designated GPL-3.0-only under the accepted Glacier license decision; the full GPLv3 text is in source/LICENSE. CMUdict package code and data have separate bundled notices. Optional remote audio is fetched on demand, not bundled; service terms are distinct from source distribution.

local_dependency_metadata_observation.scope: Verified against the bundled local app from Glacier source 1fdde8c; the packaging script records every installed distribution for each staged runtime.
